topic.angle: Woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid was built

body.question: When the Great Pyramid of Giza was built, were woolly mammoths still alive?
body.reveal: A small population of woolly mammoths survived on Wrangel Island, in the Arctic Ocean, until about 4,000 years ago. The Great Pyramid was built around 2600 BC, about 4,600 years ago.

probes.question: True or false: woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid was built.
